# About Horizon Digital

Horizon Digital is a web design and development studio based on Mahé, Seychelles. We plan, design and build custom websites for local businesses.

Custom websites built around each business, its customers and its goals.

## Working approach

- Direct communication with the person responsible for the build
- Starting prices published in SCR
- A written project scope before implementation
- Responsive design and technical SEO foundations
- Post-launch support based on the selected package

Horizon Digital does not guarantee PageSpeed scores, search positions, traffic, enquiries, bookings or revenue.

View the website at https://horizondigitalsey.com.
